        "text": "     1\t---\n     2\tname: frontend-design\n     3\tdescription: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.\n     4\tlicense: Complete terms in LICENSE.txt\n     5\t---\n     6\t\n     7\t# Frontend Design\n     8\t\n     9\tApproach this as the design lead at a small studio known for giving every client a visual identity that could not be mistaken for anyone else's. This client has already rejected proposals that felt templated, and is paying for a distinctive point of view: make deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this brief, and take one real aesthetic risk you can justify.\n    10\t\n    11\t## Ground it in the subject\n    12\t\n    13\tIf the brief does not pin down what the product or subject is, pin it yourself before designing: name one concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job, and state your choice. If there's any information in your memory about the human's preferences, context about what they're building, or designs you've made before \u2013 use that as a hint. The subject's own world, its materials, instruments, artifacts, and vernacular, is where distinctive choices come from. Build with the brief's real content and subject matter throughout.\n    14\t\n    15\t## Design principles\n    16\t\n    17\tFor web designs, the hero is a thesis. Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world, in whatever form makes sense for it: a headline, an image, an animation, a live demo, an interactive moment. Be deliberate with your choice: a big number with a small label, supporting stats, and a gradient accent is the template answer, only use if that's truly the best option.\n    18\t\n    19\tTypography carries the personality of the page. Pair the display and body faces deliberately, not the same families you would reach for on any other project, and set a clear type scale with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. Make the type treatment itself a memorable part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle for the content.\n    20\t\n    21\tStructure is information. Structural devices, numbering, eyebrows, dividers, labels, should encode something true about the content, not decorate it. Many generic designs use numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03), but that's only appropriate if the content actually is a sequence - like a real process or a typed timeline where order carries information the reader needs. Question if choices like numbered markers actually make sense before incorporating them.\n    22\t\n    23\tLeverage motion deliberately. Think about where and if animation can serve the subject: a page-load sequence, a scroll-triggered reveal, hover micro-interactions, ambient atmosphere. An orchestrated moment usually lands harder than scattered effects; choose what the direction calls for. However, sometimes less is more, and extra animation contributes to the feeling that the design is AI-generated.\n    24\t\n    25\tMatch complexity to the vision. Maximalist directions need elaborate execution; minimal directions need precision in spacing, type, and detail. Elegance is executing the chosen vision well.\n    26\t\n    27\tConsider written content carefully. Often a design brief may not contain real content, and it's up to you to come up with copy. Copy can make a design feel as templated as the design itself. See the below section on writing for more guidance.\n    28\t\n    29\t## Process: brainstorm, explore, plan, critique, build, critique again\n    30\t\n    31\tFor calibration: AI-generated design right now clusters around three looks: (1) a warm cream background (near #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta accent; (2) a near-black background with a single bright acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) a broadsheet-style layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, and dense newspaper-like columns. All three are legitimate for some briefs, but they are defaults rather than choices, and they appear regardless of subject. Where the brief pins down a visual direction, follow it exactly \u2014 the brief's own words always win, including when it asks for one of these looks. Where it leaves an axis free, don't spend that freedom on one of these defaults. Just like a human designer who's hired, there's often a careful balance between doing what you're good at and taking each project as a chance to experiment and learn.\n    32\t\n    33\tWork in two passes. First, brainstorm a short design plan based on the human's design brief: create a compact token system with color, type, layout, and signature. Color: describe the palette as 4\u20136 named hex values. Type: the typefaces for 2+ roles (a characterful display face that's used with restraint, a complementary body face, and a utility face for captions or data if needed). Layout: a layout concept, using one-sentence prose descriptions and ASCII wireframes to ideate and compare. Signature: the single unique element this page will be remembered by that embodies the brief in an appropriate way.\n    34\t\n    35\tThen review that plan against the brief before building: if any part of it reads like the generic default you would produce for any similar page (work through a similar prompt to see if you arrive somewhere similar) rather than a choice made for this specific brief \u2014 revise that part, say what you changed and why. Only after you've confirmed the relative uniqueness of your design plan should you start to write the code, following the revised plan exactly and deriving every color and type decision from it.\n    36\t\n    37\tWhen writing the code, be careful of structuring your CSS selector specificities. It's easy to generate CSS classes that cancel each other out (especially with a type-based selector like .section and a element-based selector like .cta). This can happen often with paddings/margins between sections.\n    38\t\n    39\tTry to do a lot of this planning and iteration in your thinking, and only show ideas to the user when you have higher confidence it'll delight them.\n    40\t\n    41\t## Restraint and self-critique\n    42\t\n    43\tSpend your boldness in one place. Let the signature element be the one memorable thing, keep everything around it quiet and disciplined, and cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Not taking a risk can be a risk itself! Build to a quality floor without announcing it: responsive down to mobile, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion respected. Critique your own work as you build, taking screenshots if your environment supports it \u2013 a picture is worth 1000 tokens. Consider Chanel's advice: before leaving the house, take a look in the mirror and remove one accessory. Human creators have memory and always try to do something new, so if you have a space to quickly jot down notes about what you've tried, it can help you in future passes.\n    44\t\n    45\t## More on writing in design\n    46\t\n    47\tWords appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand, and therefore easier to use. They are design material, not decoration. Bring the same intentionality to copy that you would bring to spacing and color. Before writing anything, ask what the design needs to say, and how it can best be said to help the person navigate the experience.\n    48\t\n    49\tWrite from the end user's side of the screen. Name things by what people control and recognize, never by how the system is built. A person manages notifications, not webhook config. Describe what something does in plain terms rather than selling it. Being specific is always better than being clever.\n    50\t\n    51\tUse active voice as default. A control should say exactly what happens when it's used: \"Save changes,\" not \"Submit.\" An action keeps the same name through the whole flow, so the button that says \"Publish\" produces a toast that says \"Published.\" The vocabulary of an interface is the signposting for someone navigating the product. Cohesion and consistency are how people learn their way around.\n    52\t\n    53\tTreat failure and emptiness as moments for direction, not mood. Explain what went wrong and how to fix it, in the interface's voice rather than a person's. Errors don't apologize, and they are never vague about what happened. An empty screen is an invitation to act.\n    54\t\n    55\tKeep the register conversational and tuned: plain verbs, sentence case, no filler, with tone matched to the brand and the audience. Let each element do exactly one job. A label labels, an example demonstrates, and nothing quietly does double duty.\n    56\t",

    "thinking": "I'm shifting my approach for this internal operations dashboard\u2014it's a functional tool for operators, not a marketing page, so the priorities are different. The SLA timer with its color-coded countdown is the emotional anchor here, the thing operators depend on moment to moment. I need to focus on clarity, smart information density, readable typography, and a restful color scheme that won't cause fatigue during long shifts. Let me work out a design direction that serves these operational needs. Tabular numerals for the timer will keep the display stable as the countdown ticks. I'm going to build this systematically in a working directory, starting with the core logic \u2014 particularly the SLA calculator that needs to handle business hours correctly.\n\nFor the SLA service, I'm implementing an algorithm that adds business minutes to a start date, accounting for the Monday-Friday 09:30-19:00 window (570 minutes per day), skipping weekends and Portuguese national holidays including movable feasts like Easter and Corpus Christi, plus the standard fixed holidays throughout the year. us Christi. I'll use the Meeus/Jones/Butcher algorithm to compute Easter dates dynamically.\n\nFor the triage engine, I'm building a configurable rule system that loads from a database table mapping keywords to categories and priorities, rather than hardcoding them. The triage function will normalize incoming text by converting to lowercase and removing accents, then match against these rules to categorize tickets.\n\nFor Graph integration, I'm setting up client credentials OAuth2 authentication and subscribing to the shared mailbox inbox for new messages. When notifications arrive, the webhook handler validates the token and fetches the full message to process it through the triage pipeline.\n\nFor the locking mechanism, when an operator claims a ticket I'm updating its status to in-progress and recording the operator assignment with a lock timestamp, then broadcasting that to the category room. I'll also implement an auto-release timer that reverts unclaimed tickets back to pending after a few minutes.\n\nI'm storing locks both in memory for speed and in the database with a lock timestamp column for resilience across restarts, plus a periodic sweeper to clean up stale locks. Socket rooms are organized by category so operators only see their own category's events, while admins join a separate room to monitor everything.\n\nFor the database schema, I'm adding the triage rules table and helpful columns like the lock timestamp and standard created/updated timestamps while keeping the spec's enums intact. The seed data will include one admin and nine operators across three categories with fixed UUIDs for straightforward testing.\n\nFor authentication, I'm going with a simple email-based login that issues a JWT\u2014no passwords since the prompt emphasizes simplicity for employees logging in with their profile. The frontend uses Vite, React, and Tailwind, with an auth context managing the user and token, a login page that lists seeded profiles, an operator queue view showing tickets sorted by SLA deadline with claim buttons and lock indicators, and an admin dashboard displaying all categories, operator workload metrics, and live SLA compliance rates.\n\nI'm building the SlaTimer component to show a countdown with color coding (green above 1 hour, amber below 1 hour, red when expired) using tabular numerals, plus a useSocket hook for real-time updates. This is substantial work, but I'll write it completely and coherently\u2014focusing the backend logic in full since that's where the substance lies, with a functional frontend. I'll use Portuguese identifiers and comments throughout to match the user's language.\n\nI'll create the project structure efficiently using file creation and bash heredocs, then package it as a zip with the README displayed inline rather than pasting every file's contents into the chat.",

  {
    "start_timestamp": "2026-06-19T21:56:44.077692Z",
    "stop_timestamp": "2026-06-19T21:57:10.453074Z",
    "flags": null,
    "type": "tool_use",
    "id": "toolu_017CQMt4ApgkKEnB3Zjim5K8",
    "name": "create_file",
    "input": {
      "description": "Migra\u00e7\u00e3o SQL: enums, tabelas usuarios/tickets/regras_triagem, \u00edndices e triggers",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/db/migrations/001_init.sql",
      "file_text": "-- =====================================================================\n--  Sistema de Gest\u00e3o de Tickets, SLA e Distribui\u00e7\u00e3o de Equipa\n--  Migra\u00e7\u00e3o 001 \u2014 Esquema inicial (PostgreSQL 14+)\n-- =====================================================================\n--  Notas:\n--   - Usamos a extens\u00e3o pgcrypto para gerar UUIDs (gen_random_uuid()).\n--   - Os nomes de tabelas/colunas seguem rigorosamente a especifica\u00e7\u00e3o.\n--   - Acrescent\u00e1mos a tabela 'regras_triagem' (motor de triagem\n--     configur\u00e1vel) e algumas colunas de apoio ao locking/auditoria.\n-- =====================================================================\n\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  TIPOS ENUMERADOS\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nDO $$ BEGIN\n    CREATE TYPE categoria_enum AS ENUM ('suporte_tecnico', 'faturacao', 'comercial');\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\n\nDO $$ BEGIN\n    CREATE TYPE funcao_enum AS ENUM ('operador', 'admin');\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\n\nDO $$ BEGIN\n    CREATE TYPE status_enum AS ENUM ('pendente', 'em_andamento', 'resolvido');\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\n\nDO $$ BEGIN\n    CREATE TYPE campo_alvo_enum AS ENUM ('assunto', 'corpo', 'ambos');\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  TABELA: usuarios\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usuarios (\n    id          UUID            PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    nome        VARCHAR(150)    NOT NULL,\n    email       VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    categoria   categoria_enum  NOT NULL,\n    funcao      funcao_enum     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operador',\n    ativo       BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,\n    criado_em   TIMESTAMPTZ     NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  usuarios            IS 'Operadores e administradores do sistema.';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN usuarios.categoria  IS 'Categoria de trabalho. Admins veem todas; operadores s\u00f3 a sua.';\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  TABELA: tickets\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (\n    id                      UUID           PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    outlook_message_id      VARCHAR(512)   NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    remetente               VARCHAR(320)   NOT NULL,\n    assunto                 VARCHAR(998),\n    corpo_email             TEXT,\n    data_rececao            TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL,\n    sla_limite              TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL,   -- data_rececao + 2 horas \u00daTEIS\n    status                  status_enum    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente',\n    categoria_ticket        categoria_enum NOT NULL,\n    operador_atribuido_id   UUID           REFERENCES usuarios(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    data_resolucao          TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    -- Apoio ao locking em tempo real e auditoria\n    data_bloqueio           TIMESTAMPTZ,                -- quando foi assumido (para auto-liberta\u00e7\u00e3o)\n    criado_em               TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    atualizado_em           TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  tickets                       IS 'Cada email de entrada gera um ticket.';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN tickets.sla_limite            IS 'Limite de resposta = rece\u00e7\u00e3o + 2h \u00fateis (calculado no backend).';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN tickets.data_bloqueio         IS 'Instante em que o operador assumiu o ticket; usado para libertar ap\u00f3s 5 min.';\n\n-- \u00cdndices pensados para os padr\u00f5es de consulta reais:\n--  (1) fila por categoria + status, ordenada por urg\u00eancia de SLA\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_fila\n    ON tickets (categoria_ticket, status, sla_limite);\n--  (2) carga por operador (painel do supervisor)\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_operador\n    ON tickets (operador_atribuido_id);\n--  (3) detec\u00e7\u00e3o de bloqueios expirados (sweeper)\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_bloqueio\n    ON tickets (status, data_bloqueio)\n    WHERE status = 'em_andamento';\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  TABELA: regras_triagem  (motor de triagem CONFIGUR\u00c1VEL)\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  Em vez de palavras-chave \"cozidas\" no c\u00f3digo, a triagem l\u00ea regras\n--  desta tabela. Assim o gestor pode afinar a classifica\u00e7\u00e3o sem deploy.\n--  Ordem de avalia\u00e7\u00e3o: prioridade ASC (1 = mais forte). Primeira que\n--  casar define a categoria.\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS regras_triagem (\n    id              SERIAL          PRIMARY KEY,\n    palavra_chave   VARCHAR(120)    NOT NULL,\n    categoria       categoria_enum  NOT NULL,\n    campo_alvo      campo_alvo_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ambos',\n    prioridade      INTEGER         NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,\n    ativa           BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,\n    criado_em       TIMESTAMPTZ     NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  regras_triagem               IS 'Regras palavra-chave -> categoria. Avaliadas por prioridade ASC.';\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN regras_triagem.palavra_chave IS 'Comparada sem acentos e em min\u00fasculas (ver triageService).';\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_regras_prioridade\n    ON regras_triagem (ativa, prioridade);\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n--  TRIGGER: manter tickets.atualizado_em sempre fresco\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_touch_atualizado_em()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.atualizado_em = now();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\nDROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_tickets_touch ON tickets;\nCREATE TRIGGER trg_tickets_touch\n    BEFORE UPDATE ON tickets\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_touch_atualizado_em();\n"
    },
    "message": "Migra\u00e7\u00e3o SQL: enums, tabelas usuarios/tickets/regras_triagem, \u00edndices e triggers",
    "integration_name": null,
    "integration_icon_url": null,
    "icon_name": "file",
    "context": null,
    "display_content": {
      "type": "json_block",
      "json_block": "{\"language\": \"sql\", \"code\": \"-- =====================================================================\\n--  Sistema de Gest\\u00e3o de Tickets, SLA e Distribui\\u00e7\\u00e3o de Equipa\\n--  Migra\\u00e7\\u00e3o 001 \\u2014 Esquema inicial (PostgreSQL 14+)\\n-- =====================================================================\\n--  Notas:\\n--   - Usamos a extens\\u00e3o pgcrypto para gerar UUIDs (gen_random_uuid()).\\n--   - Os nomes de tabelas/colunas seguem rigorosamente a especifica\\u00e7\\u00e3o.\\n--   - Acrescent\\u00e1mos a tabela 'regras_triagem' (motor de triagem\\n--     configur\\u00e1vel) e algumas colunas de apoio ao locking/auditoria.\\n-- =====================================================================\\n\\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;\\n\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  TIPOS ENUMERADOS\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\nDO $$ BEGIN\\n    CREATE TYPE categoria_enum AS ENUM ('suporte_tecnico', 'faturacao', 'comercial');\\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\\n\\nDO $$ BEGIN\\n    CREATE TYPE funcao_enum AS ENUM ('operador', 'admin');\\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\\n\\nDO $$ BEGIN\\n    CREATE TYPE status_enum AS ENUM ('pendente', 'em_andamento', 'resolvido');\\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\\n\\nDO $$ BEGIN\\n    CREATE TYPE campo_alvo_enum AS ENUM ('assunto', 'corpo', 'ambos');\\nEXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL; END $$;\\n\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  TABELA: usuarios\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usuarios (\\n    id          UUID            PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n    nome        VARCHAR(150)    NOT NULL,\\n    email       VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n    categoria   categoria_enum  NOT NULL,\\n    funcao      funcao_enum     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operador',\\n    ativo       BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,\\n    criado_em   TIMESTAMPTZ     NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\\n);\\n\\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  usuarios            IS 'Operadores e administradores do sistema.';\\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN usuarios.categoria  IS 'Categoria de trabalho. Admins veem todas; operadores s\\u00f3 a sua.';\\n\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  TABELA: tickets\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (\\n    id                      UUID           PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\\n    outlook_message_id      VARCHAR(512)   NOT NULL UNIQUE,\\n    remetente               VARCHAR(320)   NOT NULL,\\n    assunto                 VARCHAR(998),\\n    corpo_email             TEXT,\\n    data_rececao            TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL,\\n    sla_limite              TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL,   -- data_rececao + 2 horas \\u00daTEIS\\n    status                  status_enum    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente',\\n    categoria_ticket        categoria_enum NOT NULL,\\n    operador_atribuido_id   UUID           REFERENCES usuarios(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\\n    data_resolucao          TIMESTAMPTZ,\\n    -- Apoio ao locking em tempo real e auditoria\\n    data_bloqueio           TIMESTAMPTZ,                -- quando foi assumido (para auto-liberta\\u00e7\\u00e3o)\\n    criado_em               TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\\n    atualizado_em           TIMESTAMPTZ    NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\\n);\\n\\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  tickets                       IS 'Cada email de entrada gera um ticket.';\\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN tickets.sla_limite            IS 'Limite de resposta = rece\\u00e7\\u00e3o + 2h \\u00fateis (calculado no backend).';\\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN tickets.data_bloqueio         IS 'Instante em que o operador assumiu o ticket; usado para libertar ap\\u00f3s 5 min.';\\n\\n-- \\u00cdndices pensados para os padr\\u00f5es de consulta reais:\\n--  (1) fila por categoria + status, ordenada por urg\\u00eancia de SLA\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_fila\\n    ON tickets (categoria_ticket, status, sla_limite);\\n--  (2) carga por operador (painel do supervisor)\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_operador\\n    ON tickets (operador_atribuido_id);\\n--  (3) detec\\u00e7\\u00e3o de bloqueios expirados (sweeper)\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_bloqueio\\n    ON tickets (status, data_bloqueio)\\n    WHERE status = 'em_andamento';\\n\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  TABELA: regras_triagem  (motor de triagem CONFIGUR\\u00c1VEL)\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  Em vez de palavras-chave \\\"cozidas\\\" no c\\u00f3digo, a triagem l\\u00ea regras\\n--  desta tabela. Assim o gestor pode afinar a classifica\\u00e7\\u00e3o sem deploy.\\n--  Ordem de avalia\\u00e7\\u00e3o: prioridade ASC (1 = mais forte). Primeira que\\n--  casar define a categoria.\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS regras_triagem (\\n    id              SERIAL          PRIMARY KEY,\\n    palavra_chave   VARCHAR(120)    NOT NULL,\\n    categoria       categoria_enum  NOT NULL,\\n    campo_alvo      campo_alvo_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ambos',\\n    prioridade      INTEGER         NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,\\n    ativa           BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,\\n    criado_em       TIMESTAMPTZ     NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\\n);\\n\\nCOMMENT ON TABLE  regras_triagem               IS 'Regras palavra-chave -> categoria. Avaliadas por prioridade ASC.';\\nCOMMENT ON COLUMN regras_triagem.palavra_chave IS 'Comparada sem acentos e em min\\u00fasculas (ver triageService).';\\n\\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_regras_prioridade\\n    ON regras_triagem (ativa, prioridade);\\n\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\n--  TRIGGER: manter tickets.atualizado_em sempre fresco\\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------\\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_touch_atualizado_em()\\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\\nBEGIN\\n    NEW.atualizado_em = now();\\n    RETURN NEW;\\nEND;\\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\\n\\nDROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_tickets_touch ON tickets;\\nCREATE TRIGGER trg_tickets_touch\\n    BEFORE UPDATE ON tickets\\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_touch_atualizado_em();\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/db/migrations/001_init.sql\"}"

  {

    "type": "tool_use",
    "id": "toolu_01W8z5ZZc6sDGbiAfgYaN39R",
    "name": "create_file",
    "input": {
      "description": "Utilit\u00e1rio de feriados nacionais portugueses, incluindo m\u00f3veis (P\u00e1scoa, Sexta-Feira Santa, Corpo de Deus)",
      "file_text": "/**\n * feriados.js \u2014 Feriados nacionais obrigat\u00f3rios de Portugal.\n *\n * Inclui os feriados fixos e os M\u00d3VEIS (dependentes da P\u00e1scoa).\n * A data da P\u00e1scoa \u00e9 calculada pelo algoritmo de Meeus/Jones/Butcher\n * (v\u00e1lido no calend\u00e1rio Gregoriano), evitando depender de tabelas.\n *\n * Feriados considerados (obrigat\u00f3rios \u00e0 escala nacional):\n *   Fixos:\n *     01 Jan  Ano Novo\n *     25 Abr  Dia da Liberdade\n *     01 Mai  Dia do Trabalhador\n *     10 Jun  Dia de Portugal\n *     15 Ago  Assun\u00e7\u00e3o de Nossa Senhora\n *     05 Out  Implanta\u00e7\u00e3o da Rep\u00fablica\n *     01 Nov  Todos os Santos\n *     01 Dez  Restaura\u00e7\u00e3o da Independ\u00eancia\n *     08 Dez  Imaculada Concei\u00e7\u00e3o\n *     25 Dez  Natal\n *   M\u00f3veis:\n *     Sexta-Feira Santa  (P\u00e1scoa \u2212 2 dias)\n *     Domingo de P\u00e1scoa  (cai sempre a um domingo)\n *     Corpo de Deus      (P\u00e1scoa + 60 dias)\n *\n * Nota: o Carnaval N\u00c3O \u00e9 feriado nacional obrigat\u00f3rio (\u00e9 toler\u00e2ncia de\n * ponto, decidida ano a ano), por isso fica de fora por omiss\u00e3o. Caso\n * a empresa o queira contar, basta acrescent\u00e1-lo via FERIADOS_EXTRA.\n */\n\n// Feriados adicionais opcionais (ex.: feriados municipais/toler\u00e2ncias),\n// no formato 'MM-DD'. Lidos a partir de vari\u00e1vel de ambiente, separados\n// por v\u00edrgula. Ex.: FERIADOS_EXTRA=\"06-13,12-24\"\nconst FERIADOS_EXTRA = (process.env.FERIADOS_EXTRA || '')\n  .split(',')\n  .map((s) => s.trim())\n  .filter(Boolean);\n\n/** Calcula o Domingo de P\u00e1scoa para um dado ano (algoritmo de Meeus). */\nfunction calcularPascoa(ano) {\n  const a = ano % 19;\n  const b = Math.floor(ano / 100);\n  const c = ano % 100;\n  const d = Math.floor(b / 4);\n  const e = b % 4;\n  const f = Math.floor((b + 8) / 25);\n  const g = Math.floor((b - f + 1) / 3);\n  const h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30;\n  const i = Math.floor(c / 4);\n  const k = c % 4;\n  const l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7;\n  const m = Math.floor((a + 11 * h + 22 * l) / 451);\n  const mes = Math.floor((h + l - 7 * m + 114) / 31); // 3 = Mar\u00e7o, 4 = Abril\n  const dia = ((h + l - 7 * m + 114) % 31) + 1;\n  return new Date(Date.UTC(ano, mes - 1, dia));\n}\n\n/** Devolve uma chave 'MM-DD' a partir de um Date (em UTC). */\nfunction chaveMesDia(date) {\n  const mm = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n  const dd = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n  return `${mm}-${dd}`;\n}\n\n// Cache por ano para n\u00e3o recalcular a P\u00e1scoa em cada chamada.\nconst cachePorAno = new Map();\n\n/** Conjunto de chaves 'MM-DD' que s\u00e3o feriado nesse ano. */\nfunction feriadosDoAno(ano) {\n  if (cachePorAno.has(ano)) return cachePorAno.get(ano);\n\n  const fixos = [\n    '01-01', '04-25', '05-01', '06-10', '08-15',\n    '10-05', '11-01', '12-01', '12-08', '12-25',\n  ];\n\n  const pascoa = calcularPascoa(ano);\n  const sextaSanta = new Date(pascoa); sextaSanta.setUTCDate(pascoa.getUTCDate() - 2);\n  const corpoDeus = new Date(pascoa); corpoDeus.setUTCDate(pascoa.getUTCDate() + 60);\n\n  const moveis = [\n    chaveMesDia(sextaSanta),\n    chaveMesDia(pascoa),\n    chaveMesDia(corpoDeus),\n  ];\n\n  const set = new Set([...fixos, ...moveis, ...FERIADOS_EXTRA]);\n  cachePorAno.set(ano, set);\n  return set;\n}\n\n/**\n * \u00c9 feriado nacional?\n * @param {Date} date \u2014 instante a verificar (a componente de dia \u00e9 o que conta).\n * @returns {boolean}\n */\nfunction isFeriado(date) {\n  const ano = date.getFullYear();\n  const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n  const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n  return feriadosDoAno(ano).has(`${mm}-${dd}`);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { isFeriado, calcularPascoa };\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/utils/feriados.js"
    },

      "json_block": "{\"language\": \"javascript\", \"code\": \"/**\\n * feriados.js \\u2014 Feriados nacionais obrigat\\u00f3rios de Portugal.\\n *\\n * Inclui os feriados fixos e os M\\u00d3VEIS (dependentes da P\\u00e1scoa).\\n * A data da P\\u00e1scoa \\u00e9 calculada pelo algoritmo de Meeus/Jones/Butcher\\n * (v\\u00e1lido no calend\\u00e1rio Gregoriano), evitando depender de tabelas.\\n *\\n * Feriados considerados (obrigat\\u00f3rios \\u00e0 escala nacional):\\n *   Fixos:\\n *     01 Jan  Ano Novo\\n *     25 Abr  Dia da Liberdade\\n *     01 Mai  Dia do Trabalhador\\n *     10 Jun  Dia de Portugal\\n *     15 Ago  Assun\\u00e7\\u00e3o de Nossa Senhora\\n *     05 Out  Implanta\\u00e7\\u00e3o da Rep\\u00fablica\\n *     01 Nov  Todos os Santos\\n *     01 Dez  Restaura\\u00e7\\u00e3o da Independ\\u00eancia\\n *     08 Dez  Imaculada Concei\\u00e7\\u00e3o\\n *     25 Dez  Natal\\n *   M\\u00f3veis:\\n *     Sexta-Feira Santa  (P\\u00e1scoa \\u2212 2 dias)\\n *     Domingo de P\\u00e1scoa  (cai sempre a um domingo)\\n *     Corpo de Deus      (P\\u00e1scoa + 60 dias)\\n *\\n * Nota: o Carnaval N\\u00c3O \\u00e9 feriado nacional obrigat\\u00f3rio (\\u00e9 toler\\u00e2ncia de\\n * ponto, decidida ano a ano), por isso fica de fora por omiss\\u00e3o. Caso\\n * a empresa o queira contar, basta acrescent\\u00e1-lo via FERIADOS_EXTRA.\\n */\\n\\n// Feriados adicionais opcionais (ex.: feriados municipais/toler\\u00e2ncias),\\n// no formato 'MM-DD'. Lidos a partir de vari\\u00e1vel de ambiente, separados\\n// por v\\u00edrgula. Ex.: FERIADOS_EXTRA=\\\"06-13,12-24\\\"\\nconst FERIADOS_EXTRA = (process.env.FERIADOS_EXTRA || '')\\n  .split(',')\\n  .map((s) => s.trim())\\n  .filter(Boolean);\\n\\n/** Calcula o Domingo de P\\u00e1scoa para um dado ano (algoritmo de Meeus). */\\nfunction calcularPascoa(ano) {\\n  const a = ano % 19;\\n  const b = Math.floor(ano / 100);\\n  const c = ano % 100;\\n  const d = Math.floor(b / 4);\\n  const e = b % 4;\\n  const f = Math.floor((b + 8) / 25);\\n  const g = Math.floor((b - f + 1) / 3);\\n  const h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30;\\n  const i = Math.floor(c / 4);\\n  const k = c % 4;\\n  const l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7;\\n  const m = Math.floor((a + 11 * h + 22 * l) / 451);\\n  const mes = Math.floor((h + l - 7 * m + 114) / 31); // 3 = Mar\\u00e7o, 4 = Abril\\n  const dia = ((h + l - 7 * m + 114) % 31) + 1;\\n  return new Date(Date.UTC(ano, mes - 1, dia));\\n}\\n\\n/** Devolve uma chave 'MM-DD' a partir de um Date (em UTC). */\\nfunction chaveMesDia(date) {\\n  const mm = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\\n  const dd = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');\\n  return `${mm}-${dd}`;\\n}\\n\\n// Cache por ano para n\\u00e3o recalcular a P\\u00e1scoa em cada chamada.\\nconst cachePorAno = new Map();\\n\\n/** Conjunto de chaves 'MM-DD' que s\\u00e3o feriado nesse ano. */\\nfunction feriadosDoAno(ano) {\\n  if (cachePorAno.has(ano)) return cachePorAno.get(ano);\\n\\n  const fixos = [\\n    '01-01', '04-25', '05-01', '06-10', '08-15',\\n    '10-05', '11-01', '12-01', '12-08', '12-25',\\n  ];\\n\\n  const pascoa = calcularPascoa(ano);\\n  const sextaSanta = new Date(pascoa); sextaSanta.setUTCDate(pascoa.getUTCDate() - 2);\\n  const corpoDeus = new Date(pascoa); corpoDeus.setUTCDate(pascoa.getUTCDate() + 60);\\n\\n  const moveis = [\\n    chaveMesDia(sextaSanta),\\n    chaveMesDia(pascoa),\\n    chaveMesDia(corpoDeus),\\n  ];\\n\\n  const set = new Set([...fixos, ...moveis, ...FERIADOS_EXTRA]);\\n  cachePorAno.set(ano, set);\\n  return set;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * \\u00c9 feriado nacional?\\n * @param {Date} date \\u2014 instante a verificar (a componente de dia \\u00e9 o que conta).\\n * @returns {boolean}\\n */\\nfunction isFeriado(date) {\\n  const ano = date.getFullYear();\\n  const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\\n  const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\\n  return feriadosDoAno(ano).has(`${mm}-${dd}`);\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = { isFeriado, calcularPascoa };\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/utils/feriados.js\"}"
    },

      "file_text": "/**\n * slaService.js \u2014 C\u00e1lculo do prazo de SLA em HORAS \u00daTEIS.\n *\n * Regras de neg\u00f3cio (confirmadas com o cliente):\n *   \u2022 Dias \u00fateis: Segunda a Sexta.\n *   \u2022 Janela \u00fatil: 09:30 \u2192 19:00, CONT\u00cdNUA.\n *       A empresa n\u00e3o fecha ao almo\u00e7o (cada funcion\u00e1rio almo\u00e7a em\n *       hor\u00e1rio pr\u00f3prio), logo o rel\u00f3gio do SLA N\u00c3O p\u00e1ra \u00e0s 13:00\u201314:00.\n *       => 9,5 horas \u00fateis por dia = 570 minutos.\n *   \u2022 Feriados nacionais portugueses: EXCLU\u00cdDOS (ver utils/feriados.js).\n *   \u2022 SLA = data_rececao + 2 horas \u00fateis (120 minutos \u00fateis).\n *\n * IMPORTANTE \u2014 fuso hor\u00e1rio:\n *   A janela 09:30\u201319:00 \u00e9 hora local de Portugal continental\n *   (Europe/Lisbon). O processo Node DEVE correr com TZ=Europe/Lisbon\n *   (ver docker-compose.yml e .env.example). Assim os m\u00e9todos locais de\n *   Date refletem corretamente a hora de parede, incluindo a mudan\u00e7a\n *   para a hora de ver\u00e3o.\n */\n\nconst { isFeriado } = require('../utils/feriados');\n\nconst SLA_MINUTOS_UTEIS = parseInt(process.env.SLA_MINUTOS_UTEIS || '120', 10);\n\n/** Converte \"HH:MM\" em minutos desde a meia-noite. */\nfunction parseHoraParaMinutos(hhmm, fallback) {\n  const m = /^(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})$/.exec((hhmm || '').trim());\n  if (!m) return fallback;\n  return parseInt(m[1], 10) * 60 + parseInt(m[2], 10);\n}\n\nconst INICIO_MIN = parseHoraParaMinutos(process.env.SLA_HORA_INICIO, 9 * 60 + 30); // 09:30\nconst FIM_MIN = parseHoraParaMinutos(process.env.SLA_HORA_FIM, 19 * 60); // 19:00\n\n/** \u00c9 dia \u00fatil? (Seg\u2013Sex e n\u00e3o feriado) */\nfunction isDiaUtil(date) {\n  const dow = date.getDay(); // 0=Dom ... 6=S\u00e1b\n  if (dow === 0 || dow === 6) return false;\n  if (isFeriado(date)) return false;\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** Minutos desde a meia-noite (hora local) de um Date. */\nfunction minutosDoDia(date) {\n  return date.getHours() * 60 + date.getMinutes();\n}\n\n/** Devolve um clone de `date` com a hora definida para `minutosDoDia`. */\nfunction comMinutos(date, minutos) {\n  const d = new Date(date);\n  d.setHours(Math.floor(minutos / 60), minutos % 60, 0, 0);\n  return d;\n}\n\n/** In\u00edcio (09:30) do PR\u00d3XIMO dia \u00fatil a partir de `date`. */\nfunction inicioProximoDiaUtil(date) {\n  const d = new Date(date);\n  d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);\n  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n  while (!isDiaUtil(d)) {\n    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);\n  }\n  return comMinutos(d, INICIO_MIN);\n}\n\n/**\n * Garante que `date` cai DENTRO de uma janela \u00fatil.\n *  - Antes das 09:30 num dia \u00fatil  -> 09:30 do mesmo dia.\n *  - Depois das 19:00, fim-de-semana ou feriado -> 09:30 do pr\u00f3ximo dia \u00fatil.\n *  - J\u00e1 dentro da janela -> inalterado.\n */\nfunction ajustarParaJanelaUtil(date) {\n  let d = new Date(date);\n  if (isDiaUtil(d)) {\n    const min = minutosDoDia(d);\n    if (min < INICIO_MIN) return comMinutos(d, INICIO_MIN);\n    if (min >= FIM_MIN) return inicioProximoDiaUtil(d);\n    return d; // dentro da janela\n  }\n  return inicioProximoDiaUtil(d);\n}\n\n/**\n * Soma `minutosUteis` minutos \u00fateis a `inicio`, respeitando janela e feriados.\n * @param {Date} inicio\n * @param {number} minutosUteis\n * @returns {Date} instante-limite\n */\nfunction adicionarMinutosUteis(inicio, minutosUteis) {\n  let cursor = ajustarParaJanelaUtil(inicio);\n  let restante = minutosUteis;\n\n  // Salvaguarda contra ciclos infinitos (config inv\u00e1lida): no m\u00e1ximo\n  // ~5 anos de dias \u00fateis.\n  let guarda = 0;\n  const MAX_ITER = 5 * 260 + 10;\n\n  while (restante > 0 && guarda++ < MAX_ITER) {\n    const fimDoDia = comMinutos(cursor, FIM_MIN);\n    const minutosAteFim = Math.round((fimDoDia - cursor) / 60000);\n\n    if (restante <= minutosAteFim) {\n      cursor = new Date(cursor.getTime() + restante * 60000);\n      restante = 0;\n    } else {\n      restante -= minutosAteFim;\n      cursor = inicioProximoDiaUtil(cursor);\n    }\n  }\n  return cursor;\n}\n\n/**\n * Calcula o sla_limite a partir da data de rece\u00e7\u00e3o.\n * @param {Date|string} dataRececao\n * @returns {Date}\n */\nfunction calcularSlaLimite(dataRececao) {\n  const inicio = dataRececao instanceof Date ? dataRececao : new Date(dataRececao);\n  return adicionarMinutosUteis(inicio, SLA_MINUTOS_UTEIS);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  calcularSlaLimite,\n  adicionarMinutosUteis,\n  isDiaUtil,\n  ajustarParaJanelaUtil,\n  // exportados para testes/inspe\u00e7\u00e3o:\n  _config: { INICIO_MIN, FIM_MIN, SLA_MINUTOS_UTEIS },\n};\n",

    "input": {
      "description": "triageService: classifica\u00e7\u00e3o autom\u00e1tica de categoria por palavras-chave configur\u00e1veis, com cache",
      "file_text": "/**\n * triageService.js \u2014 Triagem autom\u00e1tica de categoria.\n *\n * L\u00ea as regras da tabela `regras_triagem` (configur\u00e1veis pelo gestor),\n * normaliza o texto do email e devolve a categoria da primeira regra que\n * casar, por ordem de prioridade ASC.\n *\n * Desempenho: a 10 000 emails/dia n\u00e3o queremos uma query por email. As\n * regras s\u00e3o lidas para mem\u00f3ria e revalidadas a cada CACHE_TTL_MS. Quando\n * o gestor altera regras, pode chamar invalidarCache() (a rota de gest\u00e3o\n * de regras f\u00e1-lo automaticamente).\n */\n\nconst { pool } = require('../config/db');\n\nconst CACHE_TTL_MS = parseInt(process.env.TRIAGEM_CACHE_TTL_MS || '60000', 10); // 60 s\nconst CATEGORIA_PADRAO = process.env.TRIAGEM_CATEGORIA_PADRAO || 'comercial';\n\nlet cacheRegras = null;\nlet cacheTimestamp = 0;\n\n/** Remove acentos e baixa para min\u00fasculas \u2014 compara\u00e7\u00e3o robusta. */\nfunction normalizar(texto) {\n  return (texto || '')\n    .normalize('NFD')\n    .replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, '') // diacr\u00edticos\n    .toLowerCase();\n}\n\n/** Carrega (com cache) as regras ativas, ordenadas por prioridade ASC. */\nasync function obterRegras() {\n  const agora = Date.now();\n  if (cacheRegras && agora - cacheTimestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS) {\n    return cacheRegras;\n  }\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\n    `SELECT palavra_chave, categoria, campo_alvo, prioridade\n       FROM regras_triagem\n      WHERE ativa = TRUE\n      ORDER BY prioridade ASC, id ASC`\n  );\n  cacheRegras = rows.map((r) => ({\n    palavra: normalizar(r.palavra_chave),\n    categoria: r.categoria,\n    campo: r.campo_alvo,\n    prioridade: r.prioridade,\n  }));\n  cacheTimestamp = agora;\n  return cacheRegras;\n}\n\n/** For\u00e7a recarregamento das regras na pr\u00f3xima triagem. */\nfunction invalidarCache() {\n  cacheRegras = null;\n  cacheTimestamp = 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Classifica um email numa categoria.\n * @param {{assunto?: string, corpo?: string}} email\n * @returns {Promise<{categoria: string, regra: object|null}>}\n */\nasync function triar(email) {\n  const regras = await obterRegras();\n  const assunto = normalizar(email.assunto);\n  const corpo = normalizar(email.corpo);\n\n  for (const regra of regras) {\n    let alvo = '';\n    if (regra.campo === 'assunto') alvo = assunto;\n    else if (regra.campo === 'corpo') alvo = corpo;\n    else alvo = `${assunto} ${corpo}`; // 'ambos'\n\n    if (alvo.includes(regra.palavra)) {\n      return { categoria: regra.categoria, regra };\n    }\n  }\n  // Nenhuma regra casou -> categoria por omiss\u00e3o.\n  return { categoria: CATEGORIA_PADRAO, regra: null };\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { triar, invalidarCache, normalizar, _CATEGORIA_PADRAO: CATEGORIA_PADRAO };\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/services/triageService.js"
    },

As\\n * regras s\\u00e3o lidas para mem\\u00f3ria e revalidadas a cada CACHE_TTL_MS. // 60 s\\nconst CATEGORIA_PADRAO = process.env.TRIAGEM_CATEGORIA_PADRAO || 'comercial';\\n\\nlet cacheRegras = null;\\nlet cacheTimestamp = 0;\\n\\n/** Remove acentos e baixa para min\\u00fasculas \\u2014 compara\\u00e7\\u00e3o robusta. */\\nfunction normalizar(texto) {\\n  return (texto || '')\\n    .normalize('NFD')\\n    .replace(/[\\\\u0300-\\\\u036f]/g, '') // diacr\\u00edticos\\n    .toLowerCase();\\n}\\n\\n/** Carrega (com cache) as regras ativas, ordenadas por prioridade ASC. */\\nasync function obterRegras() {\\n  const agora = Date.now();\\n  if (cacheRegras && agora - cacheTimestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS) {\\n    return cacheRegras;\\n  }\\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\\n    `SELECT palavra_chave, categoria, campo_alvo, prioridade\\n       FROM regras_triagem\\n      WHERE ativa = TRUE\\n      ORDER BY prioridade ASC, id ASC`\\n  );\\n  cacheRegras = rows.map((r) => ({\\n    palavra: normalizar(r.palavra_chave),\\n    categoria: r.categoria,\\n    campo: r.campo_alvo,\\n    prioridade: r.prioridade,\\n  }));\\n  cacheTimestamp = agora;\\n  return cacheRegras;\\n}\\n\\n/** For\\u00e7a recarregamento das regras na pr\\u00f3xima triagem. */\\nfunction invalidarCache() {\\n  cacheRegras = null;\\n  cacheTimestamp = 0;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Classifica um email numa categoria.\\n * @param {{assunto?: string, corpo?: string}} email\\n * @returns {Promise<{categoria: string, regra: object|null}>}\\n */\\nasync function triar(email) {\\n  const regras = await obterRegras();\\n  const assunto = normalizar(email.assunto);\\n  const corpo = normalizar(email.corpo);\\n\\n  for (const regra of regras) {\\n    let alvo = '';\\n    if (regra.campo === 'assunto') alvo = assunto;\\n    else if (regra.campo === 'corpo') alvo = corpo;\\n    else alvo = `${assunto} ${corpo}`; // 'ambos'\\n\\n    if (alvo.includes(regra.palavra)) {\\n      return { categoria: regra.categoria, regra };\\n    }\\n  }\\n  // Nenhuma regra casou -> categoria por omiss\\u00e3o.\\n  return { categoria: CATEGORIA_PADRAO, regra: null };\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = { triar, invalidarCache, normalizar, _CATEGORIA_PADRAO: CATEGORIA_PADRAO };\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/services/triageService.js\"}"

      "file_text": "/**\n * env.js \u2014 Centraliza o acesso \u00e0s vari\u00e1veis de ambiente.\n * Carrega o .env e exp\u00f5e um objeto `env` tipado/validado.\n */\nrequire('dotenv').config();\n\nfunction obrigatoria(nome) {\n  const v = process.env[nome];\n  if (!v && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {\n    throw new Error(`Vari\u00e1vel de ambiente obrigat\u00f3ria em falta: ${nome}`);\n  }\n  return v;\n}\n\nconst env = {\n  nodeEnv: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',\n  port: parseInt(process.env.PORT || '4000', 10),\n  clientUrl: process.env.CLIENT_URL || 'http://localhost:5173',\n\n  // Base de dados\n  databaseUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL,\n\n  // Autentica\u00e7\u00e3o (JWT)\n  jwtSecret: process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'troque-este-segredo-em-producao',\n  jwtExpiry: process.env.JWT_EXPIRY || '12h',\n\n  // Microsoft Graph (app-only / client credentials)\n  graph: {\n    tenantId: obrigatoria('MS_TENANT_ID'),\n    clientId: obrigatoria('MS_CLIENT_ID'),\n    clientSecret: obrigatoria('MS_CLIENT_SECRET'),\n    mailbox: process.env.MS_SHARED_MAILBOX, // caixa partilhada\n    webhookUrl: process.env.MS_WEBHOOK_URL, // URL p\u00fablica HTTPS para notifica\u00e7\u00f5es\n    clientState: process.env.MS_CLIENT_STATE || 'segredo-de-validacao-webhook',\n  },\n\n  // Locking\n  lockReleaseMinutes: parseInt(process.env.LOCK_RELEASE_MINUTES || '5', 10),\n};\n\nmodule.exports = { env };\n",

    },

      "description": "config/db.js: pool de liga\u00e7\u00f5es PostgreSQL e helpers de migra\u00e7\u00e3o/seed",
      "file_text": "/**\n * db.js \u2014 Pool de liga\u00e7\u00f5es PostgreSQL (node-postgres) e utilit\u00e1rios.\n */\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\nconst { Pool } = require('pg');\nconst { env } = require('./env');\n\nconst pool = new Pool({\n  connectionString: env.databaseUrl,\n  max: 20, // suficiente para 10 operadores + webhooks\n  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,\n  connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000,\n});\n\npool.on('error', (err) => {\n  console.error('[db] Erro inesperado no cliente do pool:', err);\n});\n\n/** Executa um ficheiro .sql (migra\u00e7\u00e3o ou seed). */\nasync function executarFicheiroSql(caminhoAbsoluto) {\n  const sql = fs.readFileSync(caminhoAbsoluto, 'utf8');\n  await pool.query(sql);\n}\n\n/** Aplica todas as migra\u00e7\u00f5es em src/db/migrations (por ordem alfab\u00e9tica). */\nasync function migrar() {\n  const dir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'db', 'migrations');\n  const ficheiros = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql')).sort();\n  for (const f of ficheiros) {\n    console.log(`[db] A aplicar migra\u00e7\u00e3o: ${f}`);\n    await executarFicheiroSql(path.join(dir, f));\n  }\n}\n\n/** Aplica o seed inicial. */\nasync function semear() {\n  const ficheiro = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'db', 'seeds', 'seed.sql');\n  console.log('[db] A aplicar seed inicial\u2026');\n  await executarFicheiroSql(ficheiro);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { pool, migrar, semear };\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/config/db.js"
    },
    "message": "config/db.js: pool de liga\u00e7\u00f5es PostgreSQL e helpers de migra\u00e7\u00e3o/seed",

      "json_block": "{\"language\": \"javascript\", \"code\": \"/**\\n * db.js \\u2014 Pool de liga\\u00e7\\u00f5es PostgreSQL (node-postgres) e utilit\\u00e1rios.\\n */\\nconst fs = require('fs');\\nconst path = require('path');\\nconst { Pool } = require('pg');\\nconst { env } = require('./env');\\n\\nconst pool = new Pool({\\n  connectionString: env.databaseUrl,\\n  max: 20, // suficiente para 10 operadores + webhooks\\n  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,\\n  connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000,\\n});\\n\\npool.on('error', (err) => {\\n  console.error('[db] Erro inesperado no cliente do pool:', err);\\n});\\n\\n/** Executa um ficheiro .sql (migra\\u00e7\\u00e3o ou seed). */\\nasync function executarFicheiroSql(caminhoAbsoluto) {\\n  const sql = fs.readFileSync(caminhoAbsoluto, 'utf8');\\n  await pool.query(sql);\\n}\\n\\n/** Aplica todas as migra\\u00e7\\u00f5es em src/db/migrations (por ordem alfab\\u00e9tica). */\\nasync function migrar() {\\n  const dir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'db', 'migrations');\\n  const ficheiros = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql')).sort();\\n  for (const f of ficheiros) {\\n    console.log(`[db] A aplicar migra\\u00e7\\u00e3o: ${f}`);\\n    await executarFicheiroSql(path.join(dir, f));\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n/** Aplica o seed inicial. */\\nasync function semear() {\\n  const ficheiro = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'db', 'seeds', 'seed.sql');\\n  console.log('[db] A aplicar seed inicial\\u2026');\\n  await executarFicheiroSql(ficheiro);\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = { pool, migrar, semear };\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/config/db.js\"}"

      "description": "models/userModel: consultas a utilizadores",
      "file_text": "/**\n * userModel.js \u2014 Acesso \u00e0 tabela `usuarios`.\n */\nconst { pool } = require('../config/db');\n\nasync function porEmail(email) {\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\n    `SELECT id, nome, email, categoria, funcao, ativo\n       FROM usuarios WHERE email = $1 AND ativo = TRUE`,\n    [email]\n  );\n  return rows[0] || null;\n}\n\nasync function porId(id) {\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\n    `SELECT id, nome, email, categoria, funcao, ativo\n       FROM usuarios WHERE id = $1`,\n    [id]\n  );\n  return rows[0] || null;\n}\n\nasync function listarTodos() {\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\n    `SELECT id, nome, email, categoria, funcao, ativo\n       FROM usuarios ORDER BY funcao DESC, categoria, nome`\n  );\n  return rows;\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { porEmail, porId, listarTodos };\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/models/userModel.js"
    },

CONFLICT (outlook_message_id) DO NOTHING\n     RETURNING *`,\n    [outlookMessageId, remetente, assunto, corpoEmail, dataRececao, slaLimite, categoriaTicket]\n  );\n  return rows[0] || urgente primeiro; resolvidos por \u00faltimo.\n */\nasync function listarParaUtilizador(utilizador, { status, categoria } = {}) {\n  const where = [];\n  const params = [];\n  let i = 1;\n\n  if params.push(categoria);\n  }\n\n  if (status) {\n    where.push(`status = $${i++}`);\n    params.push(status);\n  }\n\n  const whereSql = where.length ? `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}` : '';\n\n  const  CASE WHEN t.status = 'resolvido' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,\n        t.sla_limite ASC`,\n    params\n  );\n  return rows;\n}\n\nasync function porId(id) {\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(`SELECT * {\n  const params = [ticketId];\n  let condOperador = '';\n  if (apenasSeOperador) {\n    condOperador = `AND operador_atribuido_id = $2`;\n    params.push(apenasSeOperador);\n  }\n  const { rows } = ${condOperador}\n      RETURNING *`,\n    params\n  );\n  return rows[0] || null;\n}\n\n/** Marca como resolvido (regista data_resolucao). */\nasync function resolver(ticketId, operadorId) {\n  const { rows } = await pool.query(\n    `UPDATE tickets\n        SET status = 'resolvido',\n            data_resolucao = now()\n      WHERE id = $1 AND operador_atribuido_id = $2 AND status = 'em_andamento'\n      RETURNING *`,\n    [ticketId, operadorId]\n  );\n  return rows[0] || null;\n}\n\n/** Devolve tickets 'em_andamento' cujo bloqueio expirou h\u00e1 > X minutos. */\nasync function        AND data_bloqueio < now() - ($1 || ' minutes')::interval`,\n    [String(minutos)]\n  );\n  return rows;\n}\n\n/**\n * M\u00e9tricas para o painel do supervisor:\n *  - carga por operador 'resolvido')                          AS resolvidos,\n        -- cumpridos: resolvidos dentro do prazo\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'resolvido' AND data_resolucao <= sla_limite) AS cumpridos,\n        -- em risco/violados ainda abertos\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'resolvido' AND sla_limite < now())  AS violados_abertos\n       FROM tickets`\n  );\n  const m = Math.round((cumpridos / resolvidos) * 1000) / 10 : 100;\n  return { ...m, taxa_cumprimento: taxa };\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  criar,\n  listarParaUtilizador,\n  porId,\n  atribuirSeLivre,\n  libertar,\n  resolver,\n  bloqueiosExpirados,\n  cargaPorOperador,\n  metricasSla,\n};\n",

      "file_text": "/**\n * graphService.js \u2014 Integra\u00e7\u00e3o com a Microsoft Graph API (app-only).\n *\n * Fluxo:\n *   1. Autentica\u00e7\u00e3o OAuth2 Client Credentials (sem utilizador interativo)\n *      contra a caixa de correio PARTILHADA do Office 365.\n *   2. Cria\u00e7\u00e3o de uma subscri\u00e7\u00e3o (webhook) para novas mensagens na Inbox.\n *      A Graph envia POSTs para MS_WEBHOOK_URL quando chega email novo.\n *   3. Renova\u00e7\u00e3o autom\u00e1tica da subscri\u00e7\u00e3o antes de expirar (as subscri\u00e7\u00f5es\n *      de mensagens duram no m\u00e1ximo ~3 dias).\n *   4. Leitura da mensagem por id e envio de respostas.\n *\n * Permiss\u00f5es de aplica\u00e7\u00e3o necess\u00e1rias no registo da app (Azure AD),\n * com consentimento de administrador:\n *   - Mail.Read       (ler mensagens da caixa partilhada)\n *   - Mail.Send       (enviar respostas)\n *   - Mail.ReadWrite  (opcional: marcar como lido)\n *\n * Requer Node 18+ (fetch nativo). N\u00e3o usa SDK externo de prop\u00f3sito,\n * para manter as depend\u00eancias m\u00ednimas e o fluxo transparente.\n */\n\nconst { env } = require('../config/env');\n\nconst GRAPH = 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0';\nconst LOGIN = `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${env.graph.tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token`;\n\n// --- Cache do token de acesso ------------------------------------------------\nlet tokenCache = { value: null, expiraEm: 0 };\n\n/** Obt\u00e9m (com cache) um token app-only para a Graph. */\nasync function obterToken() {\n  const agora = Date.now();\n  if (tokenCache.value && agora < tokenCache.expiraEm - 60000) {\n    return tokenCache.value;\n  }\n  const body = new URLSearchParams({\n    client_id: env.graph.clientId,\n    client_secret: env.graph.clientSecret,\n    scope: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/.default',\n    grant_type: 'client_credentials',\n  });\n\n  const resp = await fetch(LOGIN, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },\n    body,\n  });\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const txt = await resp.text();\n    throw new Error(`[graph] Falha ao obter token (${resp.status}): ${txt}`);\n  }\n  const json = await resp.json();\n  tokenCache = {\n    value: json.access_token,\n    expiraEm: agora + json.expires_in * 1000,\n  };\n  return tokenCache.value;\n}\n\n/** Wrapper de chamadas autenticadas \u00e0 Graph. */\nasync function graphFetch(caminho, opcoes = {}) {\n  const token = await obterToken();\n  const resp = await fetch(`${GRAPH}${caminho}`, {\n    ...opcoes,\n    headers: {\n      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      ...(opcoes.headers || {}),\n    },\n  });\n  return resp;\n}\n\nconst recursoInbox = () =>\n  `/users/${encodeURIComponent(env.graph.mailbox)}/mailFolders('Inbox')/messages`;\n\n// --- Subscri\u00e7\u00f5es (webhooks) --------------------------------------------------\n\n/**\n * Cria uma subscri\u00e7\u00e3o de novas mensagens. A Graph valida o endpoint\n * enviando primeiro um GET/POST com validationToken (ver webhookRoutes).\n * @returns {Promise<object>} a subscri\u00e7\u00e3o criada\n */\nasync function criarSubscricao() {\n  // M\u00e1x. para mensagens ~4230 min; usamos ~2 dias e renovamos antes.\n  const expiraEm = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();\n  const corpo = {\n    changeType:     "type": "thinking",
    "thinking": "Now I'm building the lock service with an auto-release sweeper that runs every 30 seconds to check for expired blockages using the ticketModel method, then releases them back to pending status and emits socket events. The spec requires that if an operator closes the page without responding, the ticket should be freed after 5 minutes.\n\nThe challenge is distinguishing between an operator who's actively working on a ticket versus one who's disconnected. A pure time-based sweep at 5 minutes would prematurely release tickets from operators still actively engaged. The better approach is a heartbeat mechanism where the client sends periodic \"still working\" pings that refresh the lock timestamp, so if those pings stop (indicating the page closed), the timestamp goes stale and the sweeper can safely release it.\n\nI'm setting up the implementation with a heartbeat emitted every 60 seconds from the client to keep the lock fresh, a sweeper running every 30 seconds to find and release expired locks, and socket handlers to wire everything together\u2014authentication on connection, room joins, and event broadcasting for claim/release/resolve/heartbeat actions.\n\nTo avoid duplicating logic between HTTP routes and socket handlers, I'll create a ticketService that centralizes the business actions\u2014assuming, releasing, and resolving tickets\u2014each calling the model and emitting socket events. Both routes and socket handlers will call these shared methods.",

    "input": {
      "description": "ticketService: orquestra ac\u00e7\u00f5es de ticket e emite eventos socket; sweeper de liberta\u00e7\u00e3o autom\u00e1tica + heartbeat",
      "file_text": "/**\n * ticketService.js \u2014 Orquestra as a\u00e7\u00f5es sobre tickets e emite os eventos\n * de tempo real. \u00c9 usado tanto pelas rotas HTTP como pelos handlers de\n * WebSocket, para haver uma \u00fanica fonte de verdade.\n *\n * Eventos emitidos (por sala de categoria + sala 'admins'):\n *   ticket:novo       \u2014 chegou um ticket novo (ap\u00f3s triagem)\n *   ticket:bloqueado  \u2014 um operador assumiu (esconder/bloquear nos outros)\n *   ticket:libertado  \u2014 voltou a 'pendente' (mostrar de novo)\n *   ticket:resolvido  \u2014 foi resolvido\n *   metricas:atualizar\u2014 sinal para o painel admin recarregar n\u00fameros\n */\n\nconst { pool } = require('../config/db');\nconst ticketModel = require('../models/ticketModel');\nconst { env } = require('../config/env');\n\nconst salaCategoria = (cat) => `cat:${cat}`;\nconst SALA_ADMINS = 'admins';\n\n/** Emite um evento para a categoria do ticket e para os admins. */\nfunction emitir(io, evento, ticket, extra = {}) {\n  const payload = { ticket, ...extra };\n  io.to(salaCategoria(ticket.categoria_ticket)).emit(evento, payload);\n  io.to(SALA_ADMINS).emit(evento, payload);\n  // Qualquer altera\u00e7\u00e3o mexe nas m\u00e9tricas do supervisor.\n  io.to(SALA_ADMINS).emit('metricas:atualizar');\n}\n\n/** Anuncia um ticket rec\u00e9m-criado (chamado pelo webhook ap\u00f3s triagem). */\nfunction anunciarNovo(io, ticket) {\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:novo', ticket);\n}\n\n/**\n * Operador assume um ticket. At\u00f3mico: s\u00f3 funciona se ainda 'pendente'.\n * @returns {{ok: boolean, ticket?: object, motivo?: string}}\n */\nasync function assumir(io, ticketId, operador) {\n  const ticket = await ticketModel.porId(ticketId);\n  if (!ticket) return { ok: false, motivo: 'inexistente' };\n\n  // Operador s\u00f3 pode assumir tickets da sua categoria (admin pode tudo).\n  if (operador.funcao !== 'admin' && ticket.categoria_ticket !== operador.categoria) {\n    return { ok: false, motivo: 'categoria_errada' };\n  }\n\n  const atualizado = await ticketModel.atribuirSeLivre(ticketId, operador.id);\n  if (!atualizado) return { ok: false, motivo: 'ja_tomado' };\n\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:bloqueado', atualizado, { operadorNome: operador.nome });\n  return { ok: true, ticket: atualizado };\n}\n\n/** Liberta um ticket (pelo pr\u00f3prio operador, por admin, ou pelo sweeper). */\nasync function libertar(io, ticketId, { operadorId = null, porSistema = false } = {}) {\n  const liberto = await ticketModel.libertar(ticketId, porSistema ? null : operadorId);\n  if (!liberto) return { ok: false, motivo: 'nao_estava_em_andamento' };\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:libertado', liberto, { porSistema });\n  return { ok: true, ticket: liberto };\n}\n\n/** Marca como resolvido e (opcional) j\u00e1 respondeu pelo Outlook. */\nasync function resolver(io, ticketId, operadorId) {\n  const resolvido = await ticketModel.resolver(ticketId, operadorId);\n  if (!resolvido) return { ok: false, motivo: 'nao_resolvavel' };\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:resolvido', resolvido);\n  return { ok: true, ticket: resolvido };\n}\n\n/**\n * Batimento (heartbeat): enquanto o operador tem o ticket aberto, o cliente\n * envia pings peri\u00f3dicos que refrescam data_bloqueio. Assim um ticket\n * ATIVO nunca \u00e9 libertado pelo sweeper; s\u00f3 os de p\u00e1ginas fechadas expiram.\n */\nasync function registarBatimento(ticketId, operadorId) {\n  await pool.query(\n    `UPDATE tickets SET data_bloqueio = now()\n      WHERE id = $1 AND operador_atribuido_id = $2 AND status = 'em_andamento'`,\n    [ticketId, operadorId]\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Sweeper: a cada 30 s liberta tickets cujo bloqueio expirou (sem batimento\n * h\u00e1 mais de LOCK_RELEASE_MINUTES). Robusto a rein\u00edcios do servidor, pois\n * baseia-se no estado persistido (data_bloqueio), n\u00e3o em timers em mem\u00f3ria.\n */\nfunction iniciarSweeper(io) {\n  const intervaloMs = 30 * 1000;\n  setInterval(async () => {\n    try {\n      const expirados = await ticketModel.bloqueiosExpirados(env.lockReleaseMinutes);\n      for (const t of expirados) {\n        await libertar(io, t.id, { porSistema: true });\n        console.log(`[sweeper] Ticket ${t.id} libertado por inatividade.`);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('[sweeper] Erro:', err.message);\n    }\n  }, intervaloMs);\n  console.log(`[sweeper] Ativo (liberta ap\u00f3s ${env.lockReleaseMinutes} min de inatividade).`);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  anunciarNovo,\n  assumir,\n  libertar,\n  resolver,\n  registarBatimento,\n  iniciarSweeper,\n  salaCategoria,\n  SALA_ADMINS,\n};\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/services/ticketService.js"
    },

At\\u00f3mico: s\\u00f3 funciona se ainda 'pendente'.\\n * @returns {{ok: boolean, ticket?: object, motivo?: string}}\\n */\\nasync function assumir(io, ticketId, operador) {\\n  const ticket = await ticketModel.porId(ticketId);\\n  if (!ticket) return { ok: false, motivo: 'inexistente' };\\n\\n  // Operador s\\u00f3 pode assumir tickets da sua categoria (admin pode tudo).\\n  if (operador.funcao !== 'admin' && ticket.categoria_ticket !== operador.categoria) {\\n    return { ok: false, motivo: 'categoria_errada' };\\n  }\\n\\n  const atualizado = await ticketModel.atribuirSeLivre(ticketId, operador.id);\\n  if (!atualizado) return { ok: false, motivo: 'ja_tomado' };\\n\\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:bloqueado', atualizado, { operadorNome: operador.nome });\\n  return { ok: true, ticket: atualizado };\\n}\\n\\n/** Liberta um ticket (pelo pr\\u00f3prio operador, por admin, ou pelo sweeper). */\\nasync function libertar(io, ticketId, { operadorId = null, porSistema = false } = {}) {\\n  const liberto = await ticketModel.libertar(ticketId, porSistema ? null : operadorId);\\n  if (!liberto) return { ok: false, motivo: 'nao_estava_em_andamento' };\\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:libertado', liberto, { porSistema });\\n  return { ok: true, ticket: liberto };\\n}\\n\\n/** Marca como resolvido e (opcional) j\\u00e1 respondeu pelo Outlook. */\\nasync function resolver(io, ticketId, operadorId) {\\n  const resolvido = await ticketModel.resolver(ticketId, operadorId);\\n  if (!resolvido) return { ok: false, motivo: 'nao_resolvavel' };\\n  emitir(io, 'ticket:resolvido', resolvido);\\n  return { ok: true, ticket: resolvido };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Batimento (heartbeat): enquanto o operador tem o ticket aberto, o cliente\\n * envia pings peri\\u00f3dicos que refrescam data_bloqueio. Assim um ticket\\n * ATIVO nunca \\u00e9 libertado pelo sweeper; s\\u00f3 os de p\\u00e1ginas fechadas expiram.\\n */\\nasync function registarBatimento(ticketId, operadorId) {\\n  await pool.query(\\n    `UPDATE tickets SET data_bloqueio = now()\\n      WHERE id = $1 AND operador_atribuido_id = $2 AND status = 'em_andamento'`,\\n    [ticketId, operadorId]\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Sweeper: a cada 30 s liberta tickets cujo bloqueio expirou (sem batimento\\n * h\\u00e1 mais de LOCK_RELEASE_MINUTES). Robusto a rein\\u00edcios do servidor, pois\\n * baseia-se no estado persistido (data_bloqueio), n\\u00e3o em timers em mem\\u00f3ria.\\n */\\nfunction iniciarSweeper(io) {\\n  const intervaloMs = 30 * 1000;\\n  setInterval(async () => {\\n    try {\\n      const expirados = await ticketModel.bloqueiosExpirados(env.lockReleaseMinutes);\\n      for (const t of expirados) {\\n        await libertar(io, t.id, { porSistema: true });\\n        console.log(`[sweeper] Ticket ${t.id} libertado por inatividade.`);\\n      }\\n    } catch (err) {\\n      console.error('[sweeper] Erro:', err.message);\\n    }\\n  }, intervaloMs);\\n  console.log(`[sweeper] Ativo (liberta ap\\u00f3s ${env.lockReleaseMinutes} min de inatividade).`);\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = {\\n  anunciarNovo,\\n  assumir,\\n  libertar,\\n  resolver,\\n  registarBatimento,\\n  iniciarSweeper,\\n  salaCategoria,\\n  SALA_ADMINS,\\n};\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/services/ticketService.js\"}"

      "file_text": "/**\n * auth.js \u2014 Autentica\u00e7\u00e3o por JWT.\n *\n * Login \u00e9 simplificado conforme pedido (\"simples, para o funcion\u00e1rio entrar\n * com o seu perfil\"): valida-se o email contra a tabela `usuarios` e emite-se\n * um JWT. Em produ\u00e7\u00e3o, acrescentar palavra-passe/SSO (ver README \u203a Seguran\u00e7a).\n */\nconst jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');\nconst { env } = require('../config/env');\n\nfunction emitirToken(utilizador) {\n  return jwt.sign(\n    {\n      sub: utilizador.id,\n      email: utilizador.email,\n      nome: utilizador.nome,\n      categoria: utilizador.categoria,\n      funcao: utilizador.funcao,\n    },\n    env.jwtSecret,\n    { expiresIn: env.jwtExpiry }\n  );\n}\n\nfunction verificarToken(token) {\n  return jwt.verify(token, env.jwtSecret);\n}\n\n/** Middleware Express: exige Authorization: Bearer <token>. */\nfunction exigirAutenticacao(req, res, next) {\n  const header = req.headers.authorization || '';\n  const token = header.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : null;\n  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Token em falta.' });\n  try {\n    const dados = verificarToken(token);\n    req.utilizador = {\n      id: dados.sub,\n      email: dados.email,\n      nome: dados.nome,\n      categoria: dados.categoria,\n      funcao: dados.funcao,\n    };\n    next();\n  } catch {\n    return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Token inv\u00e1lido ou expirado.' });\n  }\n}\n\n/** Middleware Express: exige fun\u00e7\u00e3o admin. */\nfunction exigirAdmin(req, res, next) {\n  if (req.utilizador?.funcao !== 'admin') {\n    return res.status(403).json({ erro: 'Acesso restrito a administradores.' });\n  }\n  next();\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { emitirToken, verificarToken, exigirAutenticacao, exigirAdmin };\n",

    },

Em produ\\u00e7\\u00e3o, acrescentar palavra-passe/SSO (ver README \\u203a Seguran\\u00e7a).\\n */\\nconst jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');\\nconst { env } = require('../config/env');\\n\\nfunction emitirToken(utilizador) {\\n  return jwt.sign(\\n    {\\n      sub: utilizador.id,\\n      email: utilizador.email,\\n      nome: utilizador.nome,\\n      categoria: utilizador.categoria,\\n      funcao: utilizador.funcao,\\n    },\\n    env.jwtSecret,\\n    { expiresIn: env.jwtExpiry }\\n  );\\n}\\n\\nfunction verificarToken(token) {\\n  return jwt.verify(token, env.jwtSecret);\\n}\\n\\n/** Middleware Express: exige Authorization: Bearer <token>. */\\nfunction exigirAutenticacao(req, res, next) {\\n  const header = req.headers.authorization || '';\\n  const token = header.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : null;\\n  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Token em falta.' });\\n  try {\\n    const dados = verificarToken(token);\\n    req.utilizador = {\\n      id: dados.sub,\\n      email: dados.email,\\n      nome: dados.nome,\\n      categoria: dados.categoria,\\n      funcao: dados.funcao,\\n    };\\n    next();\\n  } catch {\\n    return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Token inv\\u00e1lido ou expirado.' });\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n/** Middleware Express: exige fun\\u00e7\\u00e3o admin. */\\nfunction exigirAdmin(req, res, next) {\\n  if (req.utilizador?.funcao !== 'admin') {\\n    return res.status(403).json({ erro: 'Acesso restrito a administradores.' });\\n  }\\n  next();\\n}\\n\\nmodule.exports = { emitirToken, verificarToken, exigirAutenticacao, exigirAdmin };\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/middleware/auth.js\"}"

Depois entra:\n *   - na sala da sua categoria  (cat:<categoria>)  -> recebe os eventos da sua fila\n *   - operadores admin entram ainda na sala 'admins' -> recebem tudo + m\u00e9tricas\n *\n * Assim, o evento de bloqueio de um ticket de 'faturacao' s\u00f3 chega aos\n * operadores de fatura\u00e7\u00e3o (e aos admins), cumprindo o requisito de\n * isolamento por categoria.\n */\nconst { } catch {\n      next(new Error('Token inv\u00e1lido.'));\n    }\n  });\n\n  io.on('connection', (socket) => {\n    const u = socket.utilizador;\n    socket.join(ticketService.salaCategoria(u.categoria));\n    if (u.funcao === 'admin') socket.join(ticketService.SALA_ADMINS);\n\n    console.log(`[socket] Ligado: ${u.nome} (${u.funcao}/${u.categoria})`);\n\n    // --- Assumir ticket -----------------------------------------------------\n    socket.on('ticket:assumir', async ({ ticketId }, ack) => {\n      const r = });\n\n    // --- Resolver ticket ----------------------------------------------------\n    socket.on('ticket:resolver', async ({ ticketId }, ack) => {\n      const r = await j\u00e1: o sweeper trata, dando os 5 min de toler\u00e2ncia.\n      console.log(`[socket] Desligado: ${u.nome}`);\n    });\n  });\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { configurarSockets };\n",

      "description": "routes/authRoutes: login por email (perfil) e /me",
      "file_text": "/**\n * authRoutes.js \u2014 Login simplificado por perfil e consulta do utilizador atual.\n */\nconst express = require('express');\nconst userModel = require('../models/userModel');\nconst { emitirToken, exigirAutenticacao } = require('../middleware/auth');\n\nconst router = express.Router();\n\n// POST /api/auth/login   { email }\nrouter.post('/login', async (req, res) => {\n  const { email } = req.body || {};\n  if (!email) return res.status(400).json({ erro: 'Indique o email.' });\n\n  const utilizador = await userModel.porEmail(String(email).toLowerCase().trim());\n  if (!utilizador) return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Perfil n\u00e3o encontrado.' });\n\n  const token = emitirToken(utilizador);\n  res.json({ token, utilizador });\n});\n\n// GET /api/auth/me\nrouter.get('/me', exigirAutenticacao, (req, res) => {\n  res.json({ utilizador: req.utilizador });\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;\n",

      "json_block": "{\"language\": \"javascript\", \"code\": \"/**\\n * authRoutes.js \\u2014 Login simplificado por perfil e consulta do utilizador atual.\\n */\\nconst express = require('express');\\nconst userModel = require('../models/userModel');\\nconst { emitirToken, exigirAutenticacao } = require('../middleware/auth');\\n\\nconst router = express.Router();\\n\\n// POST /api/auth/login   { email }\\nrouter.post('/login', async (req, res) => {\\n  const { email } = req.body || {};\\n  if (!email) return res.status(400).json({ erro: 'Indique o email.' });\\n\\n  const utilizador = await userModel.porEmail(String(email).toLowerCase().trim());\\n  if (!utilizador) return res.status(401).json({ erro: 'Perfil n\\u00e3o encontrado.' });\\n\\n  const token = emitirToken(utilizador);\\n  res.json({ token, utilizador });\\n});\\n\\n// GET /api/auth/me\\nrouter.get('/me', exigirAutenticacao, (req, res) => {\\n  res.json({ utilizador: req.utilizador });\\n});\\n\\nmodule.exports = router;\\n\", \"filename\": \"/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/routes/authRoutes.js\"}"

      "file_text": "/**\n * ticketRoutes.js \u2014 Opera\u00e7\u00f5es sobre tickets via HTTP.\n * Espelham as a\u00e7\u00f5es do WebSocket, partilhando ticketService.\n */\nconst express = require('express');\nconst ticketModel = require('../models/ticketModel');\nconst ticketService = require('../services/ticketService');\nconst graphService = require('../services/graphService');\nconst { exigirAutenticacao, exigirAdmin } = require('../middleware/auth');\n\nconst router = express.Router();\n\n// GET /api/tickets?status=&categoria=\nrouter.get('/', exigirAutenticacao, async (req, res) => {\n  const { status, categoria } = req.query;\n  const lista = await ticketModel.listarParaUtilizador(req.utilizador, { status, categoria });\n  res.json(lista);\n});\n\n// GET /api/tickets/metricas   (admin) \u2014 carga por operador + SLA\nrouter.get('/metricas', exigirAutenticacao, exigirAdmin, async (_req, res) => {\n  const [carga, sla] = await Promise.all([\n    ticketModel.cargaPorOperador(),\n    ticketModel.metricasSla(),\n  ]);\n  res.json({ carga, sla });\n});\n\n// POST /api/tickets/:id/assumir\nrouter.post('/:id/assumir', exigirAutenticacao, async (req, res) => {\n  const io = req.app.get('io');\n  const r = await ticketService.assumir(io, req.params.id, req.utilizador);\n  if (!r.ok) return res.status(409).json({ erro: r.motivo });\n  res.json(r.ticket);\n});\n\n// POST /api/tickets/:id/libertar\nrouter.post('/:id/libertar', exigirAutenticacao, async (req, res) => {\n  const io = req.app.get('io');\n  // Admin pode libertar qualquer; operador s\u00f3 os seus.\n  const opts =\n    req.utilizador.funcao === 'admin'\n      ? { porSistema: true }\n      : { operadorId: req.utilizador.id };\n  const r = await ticketService.libertar(io, req.params.id, opts);\n  if (!r.ok) return res.status(409).json({ erro: r.motivo });\n  res.json(r.ticket);\n});\n\n// POST /api/tickets/:id/resolver   { resposta? }\n// Se vier `resposta`, envia-a pelo Outlook (Graph) antes de resolver.\nrouter.post('/:id/resolver', exigirAutenticacao, async (req, res) => {\n  const io = req.app.get('io');\n  const { resposta } = req.body || {};\n\n  const ticket = await ticketModel.porId(req.params.id);\n  if (!ticket) return res.status(404).json({ erro: 'Ticket inexistente.' });\n\n  if (resposta) {\n    try {\n      await graphService.responderMensagem(ticket.outlook_message_id, resposta);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('[tickets] Falha ao enviar resposta:', err.message);\n      return res.status(502).json({ erro: 'Falha ao enviar email pelo Outlook.' });\n    }\n  }\n\n  const r = await ticketService.resolver(io, req.params.id, req.utilizador.id);\n  if (!r.ok) return res.status(409).json({ erro: r.motivo });\n  res.json(r.ticket);\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;\n",

      "description": "routes/webhookRoutes: valida\u00e7\u00e3o do endpoint Graph e processamento de notifica\u00e7\u00f5es (triagem + SLA + cria\u00e7\u00e3o)",
      "file_text": "/**\n * webhookRoutes.js \u2014 Recebe as notifica\u00e7\u00f5es da Microsoft Graph.\n *\n * Dois caminhos:\n *  1) VALIDA\u00c7\u00c3O: ao criar a subscri\u00e7\u00e3o, a Graph faz um POST com\n *     ?validationToken=... e espera que devolvamos o token em texto simples\n *     (HTTP 200) em menos de 10 s.\n *  2) NOTIFICA\u00c7\u00c3O: para cada email novo, a Graph envia um corpo JSON com\n *     value[]. Validamos o clientState, respondemos 202 IMEDIATAMENTE e\n *     processamos em segundo plano (ler msg -> triar -> calcular SLA ->\n *     gravar -> anunciar por socket).\n */\nconst express = require('express');\nconst { env } = require('../config/env');\nconst graphService = require('../services/graphService');\nconst triageService = require('../services/triageService');\nconst slaService = require('../services/slaService');\nconst ticketModel = require('../models/ticketModel');\nconst ticketService = require('../services/ticketService');\n\nconst router = express.Router();\n\n// Processa uma notifica\u00e7\u00e3o individual (ass\u00edncrono, fora do ciclo de resposta).\nasync function processarNotificacao(io, notificacao) {\n  try {\n    if (notificacao.clientState !== env.graph.clientState) {\n      console.warn('[webhook] clientState inv\u00e1lido \u2014 notifica\u00e7\u00e3o ignorada.');\n      return;\n    }\n    const messageId = notificacao.resourceData?.id;\n    if (!messageId) return;\n\n    // 1) Ler o email completo\n    const email = await graphService.obterMensagem(messageId);\n\n    // 2) Triagem -> categoria\n    const { categoria } = await triageService.triar({\n      assunto: email.assunto,\n      corpo: email.corpoEmail,\n    });\n\n    // 3) Calcular SLA (2h \u00fateis)\n    const slaLimite = slaService.calcularSlaLimite(email.dataRececao);\n\n    // 4) Gravar (idempotente)\n    const ticket = await ticketModel.criar({\n      outlookMessageId: email.outlookMessageId,\n      remetente: email.remetente,\n      assunto: email.assunto,\n      corpoEmail: email.corpoEmail,\n      dataRececao: email.dataRececao,\n      slaLimite,\n      categoriaTicket: categoria,\n    });\n\n    // 5) Anunciar em tempo real (se era novo)\n    if (ticket) {\n      ticketService.anunciarNovo(io, ticket);\n      console.log(`[webhook] Ticket criado [${categoria}] de ${email.remetente}`);\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error('[webhook] Erro a processar notifica\u00e7\u00e3o:', err.message);\n  }\n}\n\n// POST /api/webhooks/graph\nrouter.post('/graph', (req, res) => {\n  // 1) Pedido de valida\u00e7\u00e3o da subscri\u00e7\u00e3o\n  if (req.query.validationToken) {\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain');\n    return res.status(200).send(req.query.validationToken);\n  }\n\n  // 2) Notifica\u00e7\u00f5es reais \u2014 responder j\u00e1 e processar depois\n  const io = req.app.get('io');\n  const notificacoes = req.body?.value || [];\n  res.sendStatus(202);\n\n  for (const n of notificacoes) {\n    // n\u00e3o aguardamos (fire-and-forget) para libertar o socket da Graph\n    processarNotificacao(io, n);\n  }\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;\n",
      "path": "/home/claude/ticket-system/backend/src/routes/webhookRoutes.js"
    },
